Scope Summary: India's primary digital personal data protection legislation establishing data fiduciary obligations, data principal rights, the Data Protection Board of India, and a phased enforcement regime culminating in full effect on 2027-05-13. Applies to processing of digital personal data within India and extra-territorially where processing relates to offering goods or services to data principals in India.
Notes for Ingestion: Phased enforcement per Section 1(2): Phase 1 (procedural provisions + establishment of Data Protection Board) effective 2025-11-13; Phase 2 (Consent Manager framework under DPDP Rules Rule 4) effective 2026-11-13; Phase 3 (substantive obligations — consent, breach notification, security, data principal rights, cross-border transfers, Significant Data Fiduciary obligations) effective 2027-05-13.
